text:
ITEM 1 | Two triangular wedge pieces of baked, layered pasta-like dish with golden-brown melted cheese on top, showing browning spots, with a visible red-orange tomato sauce layer and a dark brown meat-like crumbly filling, plate-edge placement upper left; each wedge about 7 cm long and 2.5 cm thick, with a fresh tomato slice (about 4 cm diameter, bright red, glossy, juicy) resting on the upper-left wedge | 180

ITEM 2 | Pale golden-yellow crust edge of the baked wedge, slightly crisp and dry, lying under the cheese on the lower wedge | 25

ITEM 3 | Melted cheese layer, golden-yellow with light brown bubbled spots and a glossy, slightly oily sheen, covering the upper-right part of the baked wedge | 30

ITEM 4 | Red-orange tomato sauce, moist and smooth with slight sheen, visible between the baked layers and under the cheese | 20

ITEM 5 | Fresh baby spinach leaves, dark green, glossy, flat and tender, covering roughly one quarter of the plate in an overlapping pile on the upper right | 60

ITEM 6 | Mixed salad greens with curly dark green kale-like leaves, bright green frilly edges, and some purple-red tinged leaves, lightly dressed look, mounded on the lower left of the plate | 70

ITEM 7 | Thin rings of pink-purple red onion, slightly translucent, lying among the spinach at the top edge of the plate | 5

ITEM 8 | Two small, dark brown roasted or sautéed mushroom-like pieces, glossy and slightly wrinkled, about 2 cm across, tucked among the greens at the lower right | 15

ITEM 9 | Small pieces of chopped fresh green herb (parsley-like) and few small red pepper flecks scattered over the lower wedge | 3
